body_sources.w: https://docs.arduino.cc/resources/datasheets/ABX00080-datasheet.pdf page 15, section 11 'Mounting Holes And Board Outline', drawing 'Mechanical View of Arduino UNO R4 Minima', '68.58 mm'
body_sources.h: same drawing, side view: PCB '1 mm' plus header top '8.5 mm' above the PCB top = 9.5. The drawing shows no DC jack, though the datasheet lists 'J4 DC Jack', so a part may stand taller than 9.5; +z and -x are open for that reason
body_sources.corner_r: no radius published (the drawing gives '2x 3.6 mm x 45°' chamfers on the right corners and draws small unlabeled rounds on the left); 0 is the enclosing box

why: Request gives only the SKU: tests looking up ABX00080 as the Arduino UNO R4 Minima and building to its outline (68.58 x 53.34, 1 mm PCB, 8.5 mm headers, +z up, USB-C end at -x). The -x end stays open because the datasheet locates only the USB-C top edge (0.73 + 6.4 + 3.88 = 11.01 mm from the back edge, 3 mm tall) and does not draw the DC jack.
